# Test fixtures

Use synthetic, non-personal files. Do not commit private photographs, videos, EXIF GPS coordinates, faces, or other personal data.

The fixture manifest describes required cases. Fixture binaries may be generated locally by the test harness or supplied from a clearly licensed test corpus. Every fixture should record expected format, expected metadata source, expected timestamp (if any), and expected parser result.

Include malformed/truncated samples for parser robustness, but keep them small and deterministic.
